Custom Color Stone Outside Corner
18" x 22.5" or 2.81 SQFT

Home Made to Order Custom Color Stone Outside Corner
The 90° outside corner piece eliminates the need to miter panels when your installation demands a transition into another wall. This piece also creates the necessary offset pattern throughout the install. The positive shiplap edge along the left side of the piece allows panels joining from the left to slide under the corner. The negative shiplap edge on the right side provides a reliable connection to any panel installed to its right.
